comparison.objective: Tune damping from repeated carriage response vs measure a pin diameter with a digital caliper.
comparison.physical_skill: Key engagement, collar adjustment and locking vs holding a pin square while closing a slider with extremely low measuring force.
comparison.success_condition: Two non-bottoming stops and post-lock drift tolerance vs a 23.40 mm reading within 0.05 mm, one-degree alignment and at most 0.3 N jaw force.
comparison.reason: This is the closest force-control record, but it tests precision metrology rather than iterative dynamic calibration and retention. Missing rubric detail: no material novelty-relevant gap across all twelve versions.
